scene.ko: 회사 마지막 날, 처음 들어왔을 때 많이 도와준 선배 동료에게 진심을 담아 자세히 고마움을 전한다.

lines.en: Paul, do you have a minute? Before I go, there's something I want to say.
lines.ko: 폴 씨, 잠깐 시간 돼요? 가기 전에 꼭 하고 싶은 말이 있어서요.
alt: Paul, got a second? I wanted to tell you something before I leave.

lines.en: Of course. Wow, I still can't believe it's your last day.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 와, 오늘이 마지막 날이라니 아직도 안 믿겨요.

lines.en: Me neither. I just wanted to thank you properly. When I first started, I was completely lost, and you never made me feel stupid for asking questions.
lines.ko: 저도요. 제대로 고맙다는 말을 하고 싶었어요. 처음 들어왔을 때 저 정말 아무것도 몰랐는데, 뭘 물어봐도 한 번도 바보 취급 안 하셨잖아요.
alt: Me neither. I wanted to say a proper thank-you. I was so lost at the beginning, but you always answered my questions so patiently.

lines.en: Oh, come on. Everyone's lost at first. You picked things up fast.
lines.ko: 에이, 왜 그래요. 처음엔 누구나 헤매요. 금방 배웠잖아요.

lines.en: Maybe, but only because you took the time to explain things. I don't think I would've lasted three months without you.
lines.ko: 그럴 수도 있지만, 그것도 폴 씨가 시간 내서 설명해 주신 덕분이에요. 폴 씨 없었으면 석 달도 못 버텼을 거예요.
alt: Maybe, but that's because you always took the time to explain. Honestly, I wouldn't have made it past three months without you.

lines.en: That's really kind of you to say. But honestly, I learned a lot from you, too.
lines.ko: 그렇게 말해 주니 정말 고마워요. 그런데 솔직히 저도 많이 배웠어요.

alt: Oh, really? What do you mean?

lines.en: Like how to stay calm when a client is yelling. You're a natural with people.
lines.ko: 고객이 소리 지를 때 침착하게 있는 법 같은 거요. 사람 대하는 데는 타고났어요.

lines.en: Wow, I didn't expect that. Coming from you, that means a lot.
lines.ko: 와, 그런 말은 생각도 못 했어요. 폴 씨가 그렇게 말해 주니까 정말 힘이 돼요.
alt: I never knew that. Hearing that from you means so much.
Wow, thank you. That really means a lot, coming from you.

lines.en: I mean it. Keep in touch, okay? And let me know how the new job goes.
lines.ko: 진심이에요. 연락하고 지내요, 알았죠? 새 직장은 어떤지도 알려 주고요.

expressions.en: I just wanted to thank you properly.

expressions.ko: 한 번도 ___한 기분이 들게 한 적이 없어요.
expressions.note: make + 사람 + feel ___ = ~한 기분이 들게 하다

expressions.en: I don't think I would've ___ without you.
Coming from you, that means a lot.
expressions.ko: 그렇게 말해 주시니 정말 힘이 돼요.
